themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents that can autonomously perform research tasks, analyze data, and generate insights.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Covers AI tools that assist developers in writing, debugging, and understanding code.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Encompasses a broad category of AI-powered tools designed to aid researchers in various aspects of their work.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Examines the use, impact, and research surrounding AI-powered chatbots, including their reliability and user interaction.

themes.name: AI design research
themes.description: Explores the application of AI in the design process, from ideation and concept generation to user interface and experience design.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Deals with AI capabilities for condensing large amounts of text into concise summaries, useful for research and information extraction.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Investigates how AI is affecting jobs, skills, and the overall labor market, including potential job displacement and creation.

themes.name: AI recruitment research
themes.description: Focuses on the use of AI in recruitment processes, including resume screening, candidate assessment, and potential biases.

themes.name: AI research tools comparison
themes.description: Compares and evaluates different AI tools available for research purposes, assessing their features, performance, and suitability.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Covers the creation and use of artificial user personas or 'digital twins' for testing and research purposes.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
